Cambium Networks ePMP 1000 5GHz Integrated 200Mbps Radio with Built-in 13dBi Antenna

The Cambium Networks ePMP 1000 5GHz Integrated Radio is a compact and high-performance wireless solution designed for Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) and short-range Point-to-Point (PTP) deployments. With an integrated 13 dBi directional antenna and real throughput of up to 200 Mbps, this radio ensures stable, reliable connectivity in both urban and rural environments.

Built for scalability and efficiency, the ePMP 1000 supports GPS synchronization, TDD technology, and QoS features for prioritizing voice, video, and data. ISPs and network integrators widely use it for cost-effective broadband delivery and enterprise networking in Bangladesh.


Key Features:

  • Operating Frequency: 5.150 – 5.970 GHz

  • Built-in 13 dBi directional panel antenna

  • Throughput: Up to 200 Mbps

  • TDD GPS synchronization (when paired with compatible APs)

  • Supports PTMP & short-range PTP modes

  • Low latency and interference-tolerant design

  • Compact outdoor IP55-rated enclosure

  • Ideal for CPE or short PTP link

Link Distance:

  • PTMP Range: Up to 5–10 km (with GPS-synced AP)

  • Short PTP Link: Up to 15 km (clear line-of-sight)


Ideal Applications:

  • ISP customer premises equipment (CPE)

  • Short-distance PTP backhaul

  • Wireless video surveillance

  • Rural internet access
